name: Zenith The Blackjack Soars
name_jp: 究極闇を駆けるカジノ船
effects:
7 single-target Dark/NE ranged physical attacks at Cap Break Level 1, Lv.3 En-Dark, En-Dark Stack, Cap Break Level 1 & Ultimate Mode to user
Ultimate Spirit Mode: En-Dark Damage +20%, Support/Sharpshooter Casting Speed x1.1 & chases 2 Support/Sharpshooter abilities with Weakness Damage +30% to user/party/party for 3 turns/3 turns/15 seconds with at least 0/4/5 Sharpshooter/VI members (max 1 chase)
Ultimate Dexterity Mode: Dualcast Sharpshooter, Higher Multiplier & Zero Hone Cost to Hero Ability; Dealer Shuffle+: Higher multiplier & Cap Break Level 1 after 3 uses; Red Card+: 1.2s CT, higher multiplier after 3 uses
Ultimate Vitality Mode: +1500 max HP & Astra to user
